title: ESD Midterm Visuals
kicker: Embedded System and Software Design (SOC3050) · Midterm prep
lede: Three sample midterms in the real exam format: 33 multiple-choice questions, 60 minutes, lessons 00 to 08. The Topics tab explains every lesson with figures and lists the sample questions on it. Each question has the answer, a figure of the mechanism behind it, and the line to remember. Every number was checked in Python.
foot: Sources: the lesson decks (L05 slide 12 = lesson 05, slide 12), the professor's midterm guide (slides/exam_midterm_overview.md) and the study notes in Midterms/EmbeddedSoftwareDesign/notes.
